heading: Extra support during your case
guidance: Some people need support to access information and use our services. We call this a reasonable adjustment. Some reasonable adjustments need to be agreed by the judge or HMCTS. You can discuss with the tribunal if your needs change.

reasonableAdjustments.option1: documents in alternative formats, colours and fonts
reasonableAdjustments.option2: help with communicating, sight, hearing, speaking and interpretation
reasonableAdjustments.option3: access and mobility support if you attend a hearing in person

questionTitle: Do you have a physical, mental or learning disability or health condition that means you need support during your case?

no.label: No - I do not need any support at this time

extraSupport.required: Select whether you have a physical, mental or learning disability or health condition that means you need support during your case
